There, students will bond with a unicorn to unlock the steed's magical powers, and hone their riding skills to become revered protectors of the island and its magic. All while balancing classwork and navigating new friendships and rivalries; all the trials and tribulations of typical school life. Riding classes, magic classes, unicorn care and groom classes - Unicorn Academy is the boarding school of every kid's dreams. Together with their unicorns, they must all work together when an evil villain, RAVENZELLA, breaks out of her magic prison and uses her powerful grim magic to exact revenge on the Academy.
